text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide turns to me on the<n>way home one
day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you mind if we stop by<n>that cafe again?
choice_data_list: Of course not. We have the time, anyway.
Of course not. We have the time, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Thanks. There's something I want to<n>tell the owner.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hello. I hope I'm not bothering you,<n>but I'd like to
talk to you about<n>something. Not as a customer, but
just in general.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text: It's you again. Sure... What is it?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The last time I was here, I wasn't<n>able to
communicate my point very<n>well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My failure to do so has been<n>bothering me ever
since, so I wanted<n>to try convincing you one more
time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: This time, I've prepared a<n>presentation!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: First, let me introduce some current<n>data to you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Your clientele tends to skew slightly<n>older, and
customers usually come<n>alone or in pairs.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Their main purpose of visiting is to<n>read, study, or
work. In general,<n>they're lone adults who are
looking<n>to use their time efficiently.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You should take advantage of this<n>and create a
space for your core<n>clientele to relax in!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There are a few things you can do to<n>transform this
space into a hidden<n>gem of sorts and attract an
older<n>crowd.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
For example, you can dim the lights<n>and decorate
the space with wood<n>paneling and antique furniture!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And that concludes my presentation!<n>What do you
think?

At the end of her talk, Biwa Hayahide<n>is as
breathless with excitement as<n>she is after finishing
a close race.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
I... I don't know what to say. I'm<n>flattered that
there's someone out<n>there who cares so much
about my<n>shop.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text: But why do you care so much?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The first reason is simply because I<n>like this cafe
and come here often.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The second is, well...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Because I firmly believe that applied<n>logic can win
over raw talent.

Biwa Hayahide's eyes sparkle with<n>firm conviction.
Her words ring true to<n>her sincere approach to life.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When you first told me about your<n>situation, I saw
myself in your story.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I also know what it's like to feel<n>overwhelmed by
seemingly<n>unbeatable competition.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But no matter how strong an<n>opponent might be,
there's always a<n>way to triumph over the odds.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I sincerely believe that, and I want<n>you to believe it
too.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text: Wow. I...

text_block_list.name: Cafe Owner
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I think I'll give some more<n>thought to
the fate of this place.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm glad I was able to present<n>my idea
before the cafe closed for<n>good.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm glad I was able to present<n>my idea
before the cafe closed for<n>good.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I suppose all the reasoning and<n>theorizing I do
on a daily basis came<n>in handy.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I hope I didn't come off as too high<n>and mighty,
though. After all,<n>everything I've learned was
through<n>trial and error.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But I understand how discouraging it<n>can be to face
such tough odds, and I<n>don't want the owner to
give up so<n>easily.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I really hope I was able to<n>communicate that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha... You don't think I was being<n>too pushy, do
you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's hard for me to temper my<n>feelings when it
comes to things I'm<n>passionate about.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I didn't even plan on making a<n>presentation,
originally. It just sort<n>of... happened.
choice_data_list:
That was pretty good for something you didn't
even plan!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I made it. I think it helped me<n>get my point
across more clearly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm... You really think so?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear my logic was able to<n>motivate
others.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm fairly confident in my analytical<n>abilities, so let
me know if you are<n>ever in need of them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can examine any issue of yours<n>from different
angles and analyze it<n>for you.

Several days pass since Biwa<n>Hayahide and I last
went out together.
choice_data_list: I wonder what happened to that cafe?
I wonder what happened to that cafe?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It's still open and operational, of<n>course. Look.

I peer into the window and see that<n>it's been
remodeled to feel more<n>intimate. There are several
customers<n>inside relaxing.

All of them are leisurely sipping<n>coffee or reading
books. It looks very<n>cozy even from the outside.
choice_data_list: The owner really took your advice to heart!
The owner really took your advice to heart!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I'm so glad.

She looks so genuinely happy that I<n>can't help but
feel the same way.
